seo__search_description: Structured rehabilitation support at Oakdene House — counselling, group sessions, 12-step and peer support, delivered by accredited AOD and mental health counsellors. Free.
hero__intro: A structured rehabilitation program committed to recovery.
overview__text: The Outpatients Program is designed for people looking for structured rehabilitation support while maintaining their living situation. Our experienced counsellors provide comprehensive, evidence-based support focused on recovery and wellbeing.
overview__text_2: All support is delivered by accredited AOD (Alcohol and Other Drugs) and mental health counsellors, and is completely free of charge.
what_makes_it_different__text: All counselling and group work is grounded in proven, accredited practice for addiction and recovery.
what_makes_it_different__text_2: You stay in your home and community. Peer connection is built alongside professional support.
what_makes_it_different__text_3: The program is structured but designed to work around the reality of your life — not the other way around.
cta__heading: Ready to take the next step?
data__offerings: All delivered by accredited AOD and mental health counsellors
